```{r load seurat object}

sall1_mg <- readRDS("Objects/SALL1_overexpression/sall1_mg_exp1_integrated.rds")

sall1_levels <- factor(c("CTRL", "SALL1_rep1", "SALL1_rep2"))
sall1_mg$orig.ident <- factor(sall1_mg$orig.ident, levels = sall1_levels)
Idents(sall1_mg) <- "orig.ident"
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
sall1_col <-setNames(c(c("#E69000","#58B6AC", "#026D7D")), sall1_levels)

sall1_mg$condition <- sall1_mg$orig.ident
sall1_mg$condition <- revalue(sall1_mg$condition, c("SALL1_rep1"="SALL1"))
sall1_mg$condition <- revalue(sall1_mg$condition, c("SALL1_rep2"="SALL1"))

```

# Differential expression analysis between conditions

#### Basic DE analysis
```{r general similarity}

# General transcriptomic similarity between CTRL vs SALL1 OE in all cells
Idents(sall1_mg) <- "orig.ident"
avg_expr_sample <- sapply(sort(unique(sall1_mg$orig.ident)), function(sample)
rowMeans(sall1_mg@assays$RNA@data[,which(sall1_mg$orig.ident == sample)]))
colnames(avg_expr_sample) <- c("CTRL", "SALL1_rep1", "SALL1_rep2")
corr_sample <- cor(avg_expr_sample[VariableFeatures(sall1_mg),])
corr_sample
plot(hclust(as.dist(1-corr_sample)))
table(sall1_mg$orig.ident)

```

#### Perform wicoxon test on all cells
```{r wicoxon test on all cells}

# Run wilcoxon test
DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells <- wilcoxauc(sall1_mg, group_by = "condition") %>%
  filter(group == "SALL1") %>%
  mutate(DE = abs(logFC)>log(1.2) & padj < 0.01) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(abs(logFC)>log(1.2) & padj < 0.01, feature, NA))

# Many padj values equal 0, meaning that they go to infinity as -log10(padj) and cannot be plotted.
# The reason is that wilcoaux function rounds extremely small values to 0.
# To circumvent this is issue, we can change the 0 p-values (or p-adjusted values) to take the minimum value detected.
DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells$padj[DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells$padj == 0.000000e+00] <- min(DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells$padj[which(DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells$padj != 0)])

# Add to the table another column wtih outcome
DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells <- DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(logFC > log(1.2) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Up-regulated",
                           logFC < -log(1.2) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Down-regulated",
                           TRUE ~ "Unchanged")
    )
head(DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells) 

# Remove mitochondria and ribosomal protein coding genes from the DE genes
blacklist <- c(grep("^MT-", DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells$feature, value=T), read.table("/home/marinani/Scripts/Databases/Gene_lists/RPgenes_bak.txt")[,1])
diff_genes <- setdiff(DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells$feature,blacklist)
DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells <- DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells %>% filter(feature %in% diff_genes)
nrow(DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells)

write.csv(DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells, "Plots/SALL1_overexpression/DE_SALL1_OE_vs_ctrl.csv")


de_genes_all_cells <- DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells %>% filter(outcome != "Unchanged")

# plot
pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/volcano_DE_SALL1_vs_CTRL_OE.pdf", height = 5, width = 8)
ggplot(DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(padj),label=DEG)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=outcome), position = "jitter") +
  geom_label_repel(data = de_genes_all_cells, mapping = aes(logFC, -log10(padj), label = feature), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log(1.2), log(1.2), 0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(1), linetype="dotted") +
  ylim(0,330) +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#58B6AC", "gray50", "#C73E04")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj"))
dev.off()

```

down_genes_sall1 <- DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells %>% filter(outcome == "Down-regulated")

```{r KEGG}

library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library("org.Hs.eg.db")
library("AnnotationDbi")
library(ReactomePA)

DE_wilcoxauc_up <- DE_wilcoxauc_all_cells %>% filter(outcome == "Up-regulated")
DE_wilcoxauc_up$entrez_id <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                    keys=DE_wilcoxauc_up$feature,
                    column="ENTREZID",
                    keytype="SYMBOL",
                    multiVals="first")

fm_path_enrich_up <- compareCluster(entrez_id~outcome, data=DE_wilcoxauc_up, fun = enrichKEGG, organism="hsa")
pdf("Plots/SALL1_overexpression/KEGG_enrichment_up.pdf", width = 4, height = 5)
enrichplot::dotplot(fm_path_enrich_up, showCategory = 6) +
  ggtitle('Pathway enrichment') + 
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = rev(bluewhitered_colscheme(30))) + 
  RotatedAxis() +
  theme_classic()
dev.off()

write.csv(fm_path_enrich_up@compareClusterResult, "Plots/KEGG_path_enrich_up.csv")

```
